summary: Polestar Automotive Holding UK PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 8, 2026, reporting preliminary third-quarter and nine-month 2026 global retail sales volumes. Q3 retail sales reached an estimated 14,371 cars, up about 1% year-on-year, while first-nine-month volumes totaled an estimated 44,790 cars, up 0.6%. Excluding the U.S. business, nine-month volumes were 40,773, down 0.5%. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation; watch for volume revisions and U.S. Connected Vehicle Rule impacts.
